title: FancyZones/ImageResizer CLI: report parse errors instead of crashing on non-numeric option values

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The isolated MakePri discriminator used the same pinned PRI input and executable with a unique 148-character output path. It exited zero and generated a 1,111-byte XML file, unlike the earlier 262-character output path. This supports output-path-length sensitivity but does not prove root cause or validate the product build/tests. The exclusive lock was released after completion. A private, project-scoped intermediate-output override and one bounded build/test plan are prepared but unrun; the expected generated XML path is 201 characters, and NuGet asset paths remain unchanged.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
